rows.reasoning: Pierce is in the Nay column of Roll Call 382 on the HB 1296 (2022) conference committee report, the bill whose text provides that a qualifying adult is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana. Voting against that repeal puts him opposite the rung that would "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit", but it does not show whether he would "require universal background checks on every sale", "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons", or go further. No passage matches the clauses of any single rung, so the row is direction-only.
